notes: Teens also get $5 tickets to special exhibitions. The same page lists Teen Open Mic Nights (free, bi-monthly) and Teen Drop-In Art Making.
name: Teen Council
what_you_do: A group of students from schools across Kansas City. They shape museum events, work with other creative teens and see how a museum runs. You gain leadership skills and volunteer experience.
who_can_apply: Students from schools across Kansas City. Age or grade not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Page says applications are now open. No deadline posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Council application form linked on the museum's teen programs page. Questions: teens@nelson-atkins.org.
